how_built.single_fact: Drafted by llama3.1 from one abstract; pre-screened by Claude; kept, edited or dropped by the author after checking the reference answer against the abstract. Gold = the source paper (grade 2).
how_built.definitional: Written with Claude. Gold = pooled candidates (dense top 8 + TF-IDF top 8), pre-screened by Claude, verified by the author, graded 0-2.
how_built.multi_paper: Written with Claude. Gold as for definitional questions.
how_built.unanswerable: Written with Claude; outside the corpus. Pools checked: no paper answers them. Gold = none.

splits: none: all questions are used for reporting (too few for a separate dev split); Phase 6 experiments are fixed in advance and each is run once.
